Include: (1) four approved art languages Magritte/Folk/Da Vinci/Einstein, (2) existing shop-made Thursday equal-card + artistic hero, (3) date-keyed queued flyers. selection_note: Prefer morning_surprise_campaign date_plan when set for a Chicago day. Else day-seeded shuffle among series-eligible pool ids. Do NOT run Magritte→Folk→Da Vinci→Einstein as a rigid two-week block then dump old Thursday plates afterward — interleave ALL eligible approaches.

queue_and_reuse.keep_approaches: Existing morning approaches and unused date-keyed queued plates stay in the mix alongside the four approved styles.
queue_and_reuse.never_reuse_urls: Lifetime never-reuse via image_usage is absolute. Keeping an approach does NOT mean re-posting a used URL. Unused queued flyer URLs may be chosen; used URLs must fail closed (reuse_blocked) and force alternate / regenerate.
queue_and_reuse.pride_on_queued: If a queued flyer will be used and lacks baked-in Chicagoland pride text, bake a designed-in pride band into a NEW local/url before publish (do not stamp the old media URL in place).

magritte_floating_door.label: Magritte floating door
magritte_floating_door.prompt_brief: René Magritte surrealism: Sacred Ground eggplant-awning storefront (or shop door) floating in a bright cloudy blue sky over water; optional bowler-hatted figure on the roof facing away. Equal-weight clean cream modernist schedule panels (not mystic collage). Soft painterly sky, precise architecture, gold SACRED GROUND on awning. Whimsical, individual, never generic wellness AI.
magritte_floating_door.pride_placement: Cream pride band under the sky scene with clear #1 Chicagoland claim; circular sun logo bottom of photo area; website + phone in footer band.

folk_outsider_night.label: Folk outsider night
folk_outsider_night.prompt_brief: Hand-painted folk / outsider-art night: thick oil-pastel or acrylic texture, starry deep-blue sky, sun-face + moon-face, glowing Sacred Ground storefront with eggplant purple frame and warm crystal-shop interior light. Equal colorful schedule blocks on a wooden board (same visual weight). Naive joyful energy — shop-made, never polished Canva mystic template.
folk_outsider_night.pride_placement: Bold warm banner with Voted #1 / Chicagoland pride; website + phone along the bottom ground; hearts / folk accents OK.

davinci_storefront_sketch.label: Leonardo da Vinci storefront sketch
davinci_storefront_sketch.prompt_brief: Leonardo da Vinci notebook: aged parchment / sepia wash, fine ink storefront elevation of Sacred Ground (eggplant awning, Campbell St energy), Vitruvian / geometry / anatomical margin sketches as decoration only. Equal-weight event columns under the shop drawing in dark ink or eggplant. Readable serif schedule — not tiny script. Shop-made invention, not stock mystic AI.
davinci_storefront_sketch.pride_placement: Hand-drawn scroll / ribbon with Premier or #1 Chicagoland pride; circular sun logo; website + phone in ink footer.

einstein_chalkboard_map.label: Einstein chalkboard map
einstein_chalkboard_map.readability_fix: Founder Aug 14 ~2:14pm CT: concept was hard to read. Production MUST use larger thick chalk/white type, high contrast, calm dark slate behind schedule text (no dense equation noise under titles/times). Equations and relativity curves stay in margins only. Schedule columns equal weight, bold host + modality + time.
einstein_chalkboard_map.prompt_brief: Einstein chalkboard / relativity energy map on dark slate. Chalk sketches of curves, E=mc², spirals ONLY in margins or above a clear schedule zone. READABILITY HARD RULE: primary schedule text is LARGE, thick white or bright chalk (min ~28–36pt feel), high contrast; leave a quieter chalkboard band behind event titles so chalk dust / formulas do NOT compete with names and times. Equal columns for each practitioner. Small Sacred Ground storefront chalk sketch OK in a corner. Never thin faint scribbles for the schedule.
einstein_chalkboard_map.pride_placement: Large high-contrast chalk or colored pride line with Chicagoland’s #1 claim; website + phone in thick white chalk at bottom.

thursday_cards_shop_made.label: Thursday equal-card shop-made
thursday_cards_shop_made.verdict: IN — existing morning approach (keep in mix)
thursday_cards_shop_made.prompt_brief: Sacred Ground shop-made Thursday-style morning flyer: colorful equal-weight stacked event cards, clear host + modality + time, rich jewel-tone or unexpected bold color field, circular sun logo, cream contact footer. Individual / hand-finished energy — NOT the banned navy mystic AI wellness collage (no floating singing bowls, glowing healing hands, Akashic prop books, Flower of Life wallpaper). Reference readability: Aug 6 gold-standard equal cards.
thursday_cards_shop_made.pride_placement: Designed-in cream or gold pride band with clear #1 / Premier / Voted Chicagoland claim — baked into the plate, not a post-hoc sticker on an old URL.

artistic_hero_shop_made.label: Artistic single-event hero (shop-made)
artistic_hero_shop_made.prompt_brief: Sacred Ground artistic single-event hero morning flyer — one strong original illustration or photography-led composition with highly readable event title + time. Shop-individual color energy. FORBIDDEN when 2+ events share the day (equal cards required). Never the banned mystic AI navy template.
artistic_hero_shop_made.pride_placement: Premier / #1 Chicagoland pride baked into hero field or cream band; circular logo; website + phone footer.

matisse_cut_paper_garden.label: Matisse cut-paper garden
matisse_cut_paper_garden.verdict: CANDIDATE — awaiting Founder review (executed Aug 16 night on Aug 24 plate)
matisse_cut_paper_garden.prompt_brief: Henri Matisse late cut-paper / gouache découpé: bold flat jewel-tone paper shapes (coral, teal, sunflower, eggplant, leaf green), organic leaf/flower silhouettes, Sacred Ground eggplant-awning storefront as flat colorful cut-paper collage. Equal-weight cream cut-paper schedule panels with thick dark readable type. Shop-made, never Victorian lace, never mystic AI dump.
matisse_cut_paper_garden.pride_placement: Bold cut-paper banner with Premier / #1 Chicagoland; circular sun logo; cream footer website + phone.

surprise_where_landed.label: Where Did Sacred Ground Land Today?
surprise_where_landed.prompt_brief: Surreal editorial photograph: the REAL Sacred Ground storefront (eggplant-purple awning, tan stone, white SACRED GROUND lettering) mysteriously relocated somewhere that makes no sense — refrigerator, peony, seashell, typewriter key, walnut, bird nest, autumn leaf, lighthouse, etc. Everyone in-frame acts like this is normal. LOOK WHERE SACRED GROUND LANDED TODAY / SOMEHOW WE'RE OPEN. Equal readable TODAY AT SACRED GROUND schedule. Photoreal. Hard law: if another metaphysical store would use this image, reject. No purple galaxy sludge.
surprise_where_landed.pride_placement: Boutique pride band + circular logo + shopsacredground.com + 847-749-3922

surprise_newspaper_daily.label: The Sacred Ground Daily newspaper
surprise_newspaper_daily.prompt_brief: Absurdly beautiful old-world newspaper: THE SACRED GROUND DAILY. Huge playful headline. Today's practitioners as equal breaking-news columns with times. Cream paper, bold ink, unexpected color — not Canva mystic template.
surprise_newspaper_daily.pride_placement: Masthead pride claim; footer website + phone
